# **Quantum Computing Inc. Announces Participation in Upcoming December Investor Conferences**


**HOBOKEN, NJ – November 17, 2026 –**[Quantum Computing Inc.](https://quantumcomputinginc.com/) (“QCi” or the “Company”) (Nasdaq: QUBT), a vertically integrated quantum company pioneering photonics and semiconductor manufacturing, today announced that management will be participating in the following investor conferences:


-


UBS Global Technology and AI Conference on Tuesday, December 1 and Wednesday, December 2 in Scottsdale, AZ


-


Stifel Deep Tech Summit: Leaders & Disruptors on Monday, December 7 in Menlo Park, CA


Please contact your sales representative to register for any of the above conferences and to schedule a meeting with QCi’s management team.


## **About Quantum Computing Inc.**


[Quantum Computing Inc.](https://quantumcomputinginc.com/) (Nasdaq: QUBT) is an integrated quantum photonics company developing and manufacturing technologies that use light to compute complex information, capture hard-to-detect signals and communicate more securely. QCi brings together quantum optics, integrated photonics, semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging to create a more direct path from advanced science to practical products.


QCi's portfolio includes quantum machines, photonic chips, components, modules and subsystems, as well as foundry and advanced manufacturing services. Its technologies are designed to operate at room temperature and low power, without the specialized cooling infrastructure required by many quantum approaches. These advantages enable deployment across computing and AI, secure communications, sensing and imaging, aerospace and defense, and other demanding applications.


Headquartered in Hoboken, New Jersey, QCi has operations across the United States. By combining deep physics, device engineering and scalable manufacturing, QCi is working to make quantum and advanced photonic technologies more accessible and useful in the real world.


To learn more about QCi and its approach to harnessing light for practical quantum computing, please visit[www.quantumcomputinginc.com](https://quantumcomputinginc.com/) .
